verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a bulk capability is Shopify Shipping's ability to create up to 250 labels at once. That is a real but narrow bulk operation limited to shipping labels. Nothing shows bulk edits or actions across products, orders or customers, or an agent-driven or API way to run bulk jobs. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond shipping labels (products/orders/inventory), documented programmatic or AI-agent-accessible bulk API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Create up to 250 labels at once to process at scale
